nodes.label: Brahmand — E2E Chain Execution Engine
nodes.rationale: Brahmand is the execution layer of the automated trading system. It runs a 5-agent sequential pipeline that transforms entry signals into live trades with continuous risk monitoring. Design trade-off: deterministic pipeline with LLM agent insights rather than fully autonomous; PAPER mode first with switchable LIVE path via Order Agent.

nodes.label: Antariksh — Orchestration + Signal Generation
nodes.rationale: Antariksh provides institutional oversight, entry signal generation, EMA computation, and reporting — separated from Brahmand's execution concerns to keep trading fast (5-min) and oversight slower (end-of-day).

nodes.label: order_agent.py — Centralized Order Hub
nodes.rationale: Centralized order routing hub: decides PAPER vs LIVE mode in one place via LIVE_MODE flag. Agents call place_entry_orders() and place_sl_tp_orders() but the CrewAI 'order_agent' entity is DEAD CODE (never used in any Task).

nodes.label: varaha_data.duckdb — Market Data Database
nodes.rationale: Contains market_data table (1-min candles with Greeks) and option_snapshots table (per-strike LTP, bid, ask, Greeks). Populated by data_capture_v3_duckdb.py and data_capture_v4_queue_aggregator.py.

nodes.label: state.db — SQLite Trade History
nodes.rationale: Two storage layers: JSON (data/brahmand_kickoff.json) for daily state + SQLite (state.db) for trade history, orders, monitoring for analytics.

nodes.label: entry_check.py — Entry Signal Generation
nodes.rationale: 100% deterministic entry signal scoring — no LLM calls at runtime, no DuckDB calls. Uses weighted combination of Trend (EMA) + Traffic Light (candlestick) + Feedback (research patterns) + modifiers (VIX, PCR, PriceLocation). Avoids DuckDB lock contention.

nodes.label: data_capture_v3.1 — 1-Min Bar Capture
nodes.rationale: Reads Shoonya WebSocket, computes 15 indicators every 60 seconds, pushes to Redis queue and DuckDB.

nodes.label: data_capture_v4 Queue Aggregator
nodes.rationale: Multi-TF aggregation (5/15/30/60/240/1440-min). On May 21, BLOCKING issue: doesn't call update_ema() on closed candles. Also integrated to call entry_check every 5 min.

nodes.label: Entry Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Gate for CALL_SPREAD or PUT_SPREAD entry. Uses QueryTrendEMA and QueryTrafficLight tools. Output: {go: true/false, signal: BULLISH|BEARISH|NEUTRAL, confidence, ...}. NOT_UP and NOT_DOWN are two sub-flavors.

nodes.label: Regime Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Validates entry signal against market regime using query_market_data tool. On May 20+, also calls query_entry_check tool to read deterministic entry signal, ensuring coherence between gate and LLM. No learning scope (validation only).

nodes.label: Strategy Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Selects strategy (CALL_SPREAD/PUT_SPREAD/IRON_BUTTERFLY) and optimizes parameters (wing_width, sl_pct, tp_pct). Currently uses hardcoded rules; Postmortem Agent learns but feedback loop is broken — learning written to ChromaDB but not consumed.

nodes.label: Contract Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Resolves exact option contracts (tsyms) from DuckDB option_snapshots. 100% deterministic lookup — no learning scope.

nodes.label: Execution Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Builds trade dict and routes entry orders via PlaceEntryOrdersTool. Pure executor — no decisions of its own. Calls order_agent.place_entry_orders() via tool.

nodes.label: Risk Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Places SL/TP orders via PlaceSLTPOrdersTool. In monitoring phase, runs 1-min cadence via DuckDB polling for TSL, OCO logic, exit signals. Enhanced with PatternQueryTool for RL-based adaptive SL/TP.

nodes.label: Morpher Agent (Monitoring)
nodes.rationale: Detects signal reversals and morphs position (e.g., BULLISH→NEUTRAL adds CALL_SPREAD). Tool-based detection via check_for_morph. MAX 3 morphs/day. Future enhancement: add SMC/Greeks/IV-based pre-emptive triggers.

nodes.label: Shifter Agent (Monitoring)
nodes.rationale: Premium decay detection — shifts legs to lock profit when decay hits thresholds (50% HEDGE_SHIFT, 60% SELL_SHIFT). Tool-based via check_for_shift.

nodes.label: Postmortem Agent (Post-Trade)
nodes.rationale: Only agent with HIGH learning scope. Analyzes all agent decisions vs outcomes, stores learnings in ChromaDB. BUT learning feedback to Strategy Agent is broken — insights written but not consumed. Runs end-of-day.

nodes.label: Trailing Stop Loss (TSL) Engine
nodes.rationale: Activates when profit ≥ 25% of max TP. Ratchets SL downward on favorable moves. Lock ratio controls portion of favorable ticks locked in. Only improves SL, never worsens. Enhanced with adaptive tsl_lock_ratio from patterns (P3.5).

nodes.label: PatternAnalyzer — 6-TF Pattern Recognition
nodes.rationale: 6-TF traffic light patterns (GRGRGG format: daily→4H→1H→30m→15m→5m). Forward outcome horizons: 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, EOD, 1D. predict_live() returns pattern probabilities for adaptive risk.

nodes.label: PatternQueryTool — Risk Agent RL Tool
nodes.rationale: Calls PatternAnalyzer.predict_live() to fetch current pattern + outcome probabilities. Converts probabilities → actionable SL/TP parameters via _pattern_to_risk_guidance(). Wired as first risk agent tool.

nodes.label: order_ledger.json — Order-Level Tracking
nodes.rationale: Hot cache for active trades. Order-level detail with real-time updates. Each order links to trade_id. PAPER mode orders marked FILLED immediately.

nodes.label: trade_execution.duckdb — Permanent Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Three tables: active_trades (risk monitor reads), trade_history (postmortem analysis), monitoring_log (audit trail). Should be written atomically by order_agent.

nodes.label: EntryCheckTool — Fallback Chain
nodes.rationale: 3-layer fallback: (1) /tmp/entry_check_latest.json, (2) log file, (3) DuckDB direct. Ensures entry signal always available with fault tolerance.

nodes.label: Redis v3_ohlcv_queue
nodes.rationale: Receives 1-min bars from v3.1 every 60 seconds with 15 indicator fields. Source for entry_check's traffic_light and trend scoring.

nodes.label: ChromaDB Research Pattern Store
nodes.rationale: Stores approved patterns with 7-day expiry. Used by Postmortem Agent for learning and EntrySignalBroker for feedback matching. Located at /tmp/chroma_research/.

nodes.label: daily_config.json — Learned Parameters
nodes.rationale: Updated by Daily Config Updater Agent with learned SL/TP/strategy/entry/exit parameters. Read by Strategy Planning Agent on next day's pre-market phase. Currently broken: learning written to ChromaDB but NOT fed back to Strategy Agent.

nodes.label: EMA State Files — Persistent Trend Data
nodes.rationale: Pickle files at /antariksh/ema_state/NIFTY_{1,5,15,60}.pkl. Must be fresh for entry signals. Populated by brahmand.ema_aggregator.update_ema() — BLOCKING: v4 aggregator doesn't call this.
nodes.norm_label: ema state files — persistent trend data

nodes.label: entry_check_latest.json — Entry Signal Output
nodes.rationale: At /antariksh/entry_signals/entry_check_latest.json. Contains signal (GO/NO-GO), score (0-100), ema_trend, traffic_light, timestamp. Updated every 5 min by entry_check or v4 aggregator.

nodes.label: brahmand_kickoff.json — Daily State
nodes.rationale: Persistent daily state JSON with date, trades_today, active_trade (legs, SL/TP), all_trades history, post_mortem_done flag. Fast reads for kickoff scheduler.

nodes.label: Traffic Light System — 6 TF + Gap
nodes.rationale: 6 timeframes candle colors (GREEN/RED) + 7th parameter (gap direction from prev_close). Gap weight=0.2 configurable in entry_weights.json. RL can tune gap_weight, score_boost, confidence_adjust post-session.

nodes.label: DeepSeek API — LLM Backend
nodes.rationale: LLM used by CrewAI agents (Entry, Regime, Strategy, Contract, Execution, Risk). When unavailable, system falls back to _deterministic_fallback().

nodes.label: CrewAI Framework
nodes.rationale: Orchestration framework: Process.sequential for entry crew, context passing between agents via context=[prior_tasks]. Agents created via AgentFactory (factory.py).

nodes.label: ResearchBacktestOrchestrator
nodes.rationale: Nightly research pipeline: 5 research agents discover patterns, backtest against 13 trading days (4995 candles), approve/reject patterns (70% win rate threshold), store in ChromaDB.

nodes.label: Position Morphing State Machine
nodes.rationale: 6 transition scenarios: BULLISH↔NEUTRAL, BEARISH↔NEUTRAL, BULLISH↔BEARISH. Each morph books P&L on closed legs, adds/removes legs, updates SL/TP. MAX_MORPHS=3/day. Implemented at position_manager.py:386-560.

nodes.label: Brahmand
nodes.description: E2E execution engine for options trading, 5-agent sequential pipeline plus research/backtest system

nodes.description: Orchestration and signal generation system, sister project to Brahmand

nodes.label: Tauric Framework
nodes.description: LangGraph-based multi-agent trading framework from tauricresearch/tradingagents. 4 teams (Analyst, Researcher, Trader, Risk/PM) with ~12 agents. Debate framework as key reusable pattern.

nodes.label: Build Plan MVC
nodes.description: 3-agent CrewAI Flow build plan: 11 steps across 3 waves (Foundation → Agents → Flow+Tests). Architecture: Execution + Risk + Post-Mortem agents.

nodes.label: DeepSeek Build Specification

nodes.label: Wave 1: Foundation
nodes.description: 5 files: schemas.py (Pydantic models), agents_registry.yaml, tools_registry.yaml, persistence.py (SQLite state.db), factory.py (AgentFactory+ToolFactory). Status: COMPLETE.

nodes.label: Order Agent
nodes.description: Centralized order routing hub. Single decision point for PAPER/LIVE mode. place_entry_orders() and place_sl_tp_orders(). PAPER mode writes to order_ledger.json. LIVE mode forwards to Shoonya API. Added during refactoring.

nodes.label: Strategy Planning Agent
nodes.description: Plans which strategy to use. Multi-factor scoring: win_rate, entry_signal_reliability, exit_timing_success, greek_suitability, vix_adjustment, market_structure. Queries strategy_knowledge from ChromaDB.

nodes.label: Entry Planning Agent
nodes.description: Plans entry signals + entry window. Scores signals by success_rate, premium_captured, slippage, time_of_day, confluence. Ranks signals, recommends primary + backup.

nodes.label: Exit Planning Agent
nodes.description: Plans exit conditions + optimal hold time. Scores exit methods: time-based, TP hit, resistance, structure break, Greeks. Recommends primary + secondary exit triggers.

nodes.label: Daily Plan Synthesizer Agent
nodes.description: Combines all planning agents' outputs → daily_trade_plan.json. Includes regime, strategy, entry, exit, risk plans + contracts + execution sequence.

nodes.label: Strategy Post-Mortem Agent
nodes.description: Analyzes: Was strategy choice correct for the regime? Publishes to strategy_knowledge collection. Tracks win_rate and confidence per strategy-regime pair.

nodes.label: Entry Post-Mortem Agent
nodes.description: Analyzes: Was entry timing optimal? Which signal worked? Tracks distance_from_support, EMA alignment, RSI, premium_captured, slippage, time_of_day. Publishes to entry_knowledge.

nodes.label: Exit Post-Mortem Agent
nodes.description: Analyzes: Was exit timing optimal? Should hold longer/shorter? Tracks hold_time, profit_captured_pct, exit_reason, counterfactual. Publishes to exit_knowledge.

nodes.label: Daily Config Updater Agent
nodes.description: Synthesizes post-mortem learnings → updates daily_config.json for tomorrow. Evolves confidence, win_rates, entry windows, hold times, risk params.

nodes.label: SuperTrend Research Agent
nodes.description: Discovers ADX momentum patterns. 121 matches across 13 trading days. 100% reliable. Family weight: 0.87. Pattern: ADX > 30.

nodes.label: PCR Research Agent
nodes.description: Discovers PCR mean reversion patterns. 560 matches, 9/13 days. Family weight: 0.72. Pattern: PCR_MR_001 (high PCR predicts DOWN, low PCR predicts UP).

nodes.label: EMA Research Agent
nodes.description: Discovers RSI mean reversion patterns. 122 matches, 13/13 days. Family weight reduced from 0.77 → 0.30 (not producing patterns).

nodes.label: Volatility Research Agent
nodes.description: Discovers VIX spike alerts. 685 matches, 11/13 days. Family weight reduced from 0.68 → 0.40 (too noisy, matches almost every minute).

nodes.label: Iron Butterfly Strategy
nodes.description: Neutral options strategy: SELL ATM CE/PE + BUY OTM wings (ATM ± 300). Best in sideways regime (ADX < 25). WINGS_FIRST execution. 0 DTE. 82% win-rate in sideways. 4-leg execution.

nodes.label: Mock Mode
nodes.description: Controlled by ANTARIKSH_MOCK_MODE env var. No real broker API calls. Paper trading with simulated fills.

nodes.label: Paper Trading Mode
nodes.description: Live market data, simulated broker. All orders logged to order_ledger.json. Default mode (BRAHMAND_MODE=PAPER).

nodes.label: Live Trading Mode
nodes.description: Real broker orders via Shoonya API. Controlled by BRAHMAND_MODE env var and LIVE_MODE flag in order_agent.py.

nodes.label: Weighted Pattern System
nodes.description: Multi-family weighted voting: SuperTrend 0.87, PCR 0.75, EMA 0.30, VIX 0.40. Confidence = sum(pattern_score × family_weight). ENTRY if confidence > 0.75. Pattern quality scaled by hit_rate.

nodes.label: Circadian Rhythm Loop
nodes.description: 24-hour trading cycle: Pre-market planning 09:15 → Intraday execution 09:15-15:30 → Post-market learning 16:00 → Nightly research 23:00 → Next day planning. Closed loop with daily_config.json feedback.

nodes.label: 3-Phase System
nodes.description: Phase 1: Pre-Market Planning (7 agents → daily_trade_plan.json). Phase 2: Intraday Execution (every 5 min, regime monitor + execution + risk). Phase 3: Post-Market Learning (4 agents → daily_config.json).

nodes.label: Morphing
nodes.description: Signal reversal detection. When entry signal flips (BEARISH→BULLISH or reverse), close losing leg, open opposite leg. Max 3 morphs per trade. Cancels old SL/TP orders, places new ones.

nodes.label: Leg Shifting
nodes.description: Premium decay-driven adjustment. 50% decay → HEDGE_SHIFT (new hedge leg, cancel old). 60% decay → SELL_SHIFT (new sell leg, cancel old, book P&L). Each leg treated as independent trade.

nodes.label: Trailing Stop Loss (TSL)
nodes.description: Activates at 33% of max profit. Ratchets up on favorable moves. TSL exit tracked separately. Used in full risk management backtest.

nodes.label: Debate Framework
nodes.description: Tauric pattern: Bullish Researcher + Bearish Researcher + Synthesizer vote. To be ported post-MVP. Adds 3 LLM calls per decision. Gating condition: consensus >= 70%.

nodes.label: Analyst Decomposition
nodes.description: Tauric pattern: split analysis into 4 dimensions (Fundamentals, Sentiment, News, Technical). Adapted for options: IV Rank, Theta Decay, Delta Hedge, Event Risk analysts.

nodes.label: E2E Entry Chain
nodes.description: 8-step sequential pipeline: NOT_UP/NOT_DOWN Entry Agents → Regime Agent → Strategy Agent → Contract Agent → Execution Agent → Order Agent (via PlaceEntryOrdersTool) → Risk Agent (via PlaceSLTPOrdersTool).

nodes.label: Research Discovery Pipeline
nodes.description: Nightly: 4 Research Agents discover patterns → Backtest against 13 trading days → Validate (auto-approve) → Store in ChromaDB → Send Telegram summary. Cron at 23:00.

nodes.label: Entry Signal Pipeline
nodes.description: 9:15 AM: Entry Agent loads patterns from ChromaDB → Every 1-min: checks candle against patterns → Calculates weighted confidence → If > 0.70: generates signal → Telegram notification.
